text: The memos said something about a shipment number…
Shipment 7742. Only the last three digits.
7… 4… 2. Has to be.
Route 12 opens into the checkpoint corridor. Stay slow.
Blast pattern is too clean for a panic bombing.
Static is pooling down here. Something jammed the channel.
Government tread, checkpoint equipment... keep your heads down.
Did anyone else see that flash above the gantry?
Route 12 will be remembered as the day KRAP discipline failed the nation.
Effective immediately, KRAP operations in the highway corridor fall under government review.
All units. The KRAP operator is the primary suspect. Bring him in. Authorization IPA-Code Omega.
You told them I was a coward, Biribel. / A fake. / Tonight I tell the nation what you are.
When the address ends, so do you. / That is not a threat. / That is a schedule.
Six years I have waited to show the nation what a KRAP lie looks like. Up close. On camera.
They'll see your face, Biribel. They'll hear Route 12. And then they'll see what happens to people who leak rumors about their Prime Minister.
At twenty-two hundred, the President names you. Route 12. By face. I made sure the file is... thorough.
Oh, save it. This tape is one-way. I'm told the acoustics in here are... unkind.
Door's kicked. Camera loop: four minutes, maybe less. I get you out, you get me clear. Move.
I came in through their own back door. Same way out, if you keep up. Move, operator. Move.
Too loud now. Move!
Alarm's up. I'll draw them off, you move.
I bought you seconds. Make the leg useful, then move.
They're awake now. South hall, move.
Thirteen names closed. One name opened.
Biribel! Take the radio. I draw them off, you get the relay alive.
Out? Here. Two more. Make them count.
Out?! Catch!
Mag up, move!
Stay lethal!
Authorization is good. Get back to the relay.
On your six. Move.
Back on your six. Call when you're dry, I've got mags.
I'm with you. Stacks west, vault northeast. Don't dry the mag, I'll toss you one.
Dry? Catch, don't make me regret this!
Mag! Keep pushing the stacks!
Last spare. Make them count!
The only unforged copy is under glass in the cold vault. Take it. Then the north stairwell, Balaceanu's sweep is already moving.
I've got your back to the door. Go.
They will burn the wing when they realize. Don't look back.
My van's still staged at the dock, I haven't bailed on you yet. Through that smoke, friend, and don't make me regret it.
Sweep teams: the prisoner is in the lobby levels. Free fire, my address begins at 22:00, and I will not be interrupted.
Sweep teams, report. The prisoner carries state property. My address begins at 22:00, and he will not outlive it.
Contact - shield point ahead! His sight cone is narrow: go around it, friend.
Window's closing. My engine idles for no one - not even you.
Shield point is down - the south is open. Push, friend.
Volkov's patience is a resource. Spend it wisely.

text: Forty-five seconds. Then I'm a memory.
Dock gates open. No van waiting - move.
Their marksman is gone. Dock gates are open - I'll cycle the door when you get there.
...The van's gone. Dock crane, roof line - you're resourceful. Sorry, friend.
Behind me. Door cycles in forty-five. I'll keep them off it.
No van. The crane cage lifts to the roof line - hold the dock until it clears.
Van's held - sweep teams still on you. Clear them, then we roll!
Roof line confirmed. You're a ghost again, Biribel. Now - the broadcast.
File's aboard. I drive, you watch the mirrors. DRIVE!
The prisoner is contained. At twenty-two hundred I will close the matter of Route 12, on camera, before the nation.
I'm on your six. You take the desk, I'll hold the floor.
Twenty-two hundred. The address is finished. The prisoner is contained. Route 12 is closed.
What is this? Cut the feed. CUT THE FEED!
Six years he spent building it. You read it in one minute.
This isn't a crackdown - it's a collapse. Stay off the boulevard.
